subject: Follow-up: Multilingual model fit & evals — EU/APAC next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@globexretail.it>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 14:02:00 +0200
Subject: Follow-up: Multilingual model fit & evals — EU/APAC next steps

Hi Elena / Pierre —

Thanks again for the intro call today — great to hear more about Globex Retail's plan to roll out localized customer support agents across ITA/FR/DE and test pilots for JP/KR in Q4. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

1) Recommended model candidates to test (initial eval):
   - redwood-multi-16B-q4: best tradeoff we saw for EU languages on intent/slot accuracy.
   - redwood-instruct-8B-8bit: lower latency path, good for short-turn support flows.
   - redwood-llm-7B-sparse: cheap baseline for embeddings and reranking.

2) Evaluation plan we propose:
   - You share ~300 representative utterances per target locale (ITA, FRA, DEU, JPN, KOR). Prefer a CSV with: id, locale, text, expected_intent, expected_entities.
   - We run our multilingual eval harness (redwood-evals) and return per-language Precision/Recall/F1, top-1 intent accuracy, hallucination rate sample, and a short summary of prompt sensitivity.
   - Timeline: initial results within 48–72 hours after receiving samples.

3) Quality/regression notes from today's session:
   - We flagged potential regressions for technical support domain in Italian (forms & product codes) vs. our EN baseline — we will include focused prompt sets to stress test codes and truncated context.
   - Japanese polite-form handling and honorifics can reduce slot accuracy; we'll run formality-aware prompts.

4) Privacy / residency options: we can run evals on our hosted infra (default), or if you prefer data-residency/air-gapped, we can run the eval in a Dedicated pool in eu-west-1 or via Private deployment — I noted you asked about retention and SOC2 evidence.

Attachments: multilingual_prompt_set_v1.csv (template), benchmark-results-eu-apac-20260812.pdf (sample), data_share_instructions.txt

Next steps: Please confirm which locale samples you can share and whether running evals on hosted infra is OK, or if you need Dedicated/Private. Once you send samples I'll kick off the eval job and share the results + a short write-up.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0132

---

Note: redwood-evals dashboard: https://redwood-inference.internal/evals/GLX-2026-042
\

From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@globexretail.it>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Pierre Dupont <p.dupont@eurobank.fr>
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 09:21:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Multilingual model fit & evals — EU/APAC next steps

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the detailed recap. We're happy to proceed. A few clarifications: 

- Timeline: 48–72 hours after sample delivery works for us. Can you confirm if the evals will include per-language confusion matrices and sample failed cases? Useful for our product team.
- Residency: For the initial evals, hosted infra is fine, but for any later POC we will require EU data residency. SOC2 + audit logs would be a requirement for production.
- I've attached a ZIP with ~300 utterances for ITA/FRA/DEU (sample_upload_v1.zip). We'll prepare JP/KR samples next week.

Also — on pricing: what's the expected cost to run a full 5-locale eval and a single production canary for one month? (high-level ballpark ok).

Thanks,
Elena
Head of CX Automation, Globex Retail
\

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@globexretail.it>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 11:05:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Multilingual model fit & evals — EU/APAC next steps

Elena —

Appreciate the fast turnaround and the sample upload. Confirming: our eval includes per-locale confusion matrices, top failure cases (we'll include ~20 representative failures per locale), and prompt-sensitivity analysis. We'll also attach a short 'what to do next' doc for each language highlighting prompt tweaks and quantization/latency tradeoffs.

Regarding residency and SOC2: for the short eval we'll run on hosted infra; we will not persist the samples beyond the eval job run. For production POC we'll propose a Dedicated pool in eu-west-1 or a Private deployment; both options include SOC2-compliant logging and KMS-backed keys. I've CC'd Vivek to confirm the retention SLA and Neha for pricing.

I'll start the eval when I get confirmation that the ZIP upload is the final set you want tested. Expect an email with initial results by Fri EOD (48h).

Best,
Marissa
\

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 12:40:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Multilingual model fit & evals — EU/APAC next steps

Quick internal note:

- Pricing (ballpark) for Elena's ask: one-time eval run across 5 locales + report: ~$2.5k–3.5k depending on model candidates (higher end if we include 16B+ runs).
- Production canary (single region, 1 month reserved Dedicated capacity small pool): monthly estimate $18k–25k depending on concurrency and latency SLOs. Include a credit line if they commit to annual.
- Technical: watch for EU latency on redwood-multi-16B-q4 when running with long context (>=1024 tokens); we may prefer redwood-instruct-8B for their low-latency support flows.

I'll draft the formal quote after we see the eval results.
\-neha
\

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@globexretail.it>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 10:18:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Multilingual model fit & evals — EU/APAC next steps

Elena —

Got it, thank you — we've started the eval job (job id: GLX-2026-042-EVAL-01) against the ZIP you uploaded. Link to live run and interim metrics here: https://redwood-inference.internal/evals/GLX-2026-042

Deliverables you'll receive by EOD today:
- Per-locale summary table (Precision/Recall/F1), confusion matrices, ~20 failure cases per locale.
- Prompt set recommendations (attached: multilingual_prompt_set_v1.csv).
- Short recommendations doc on latency vs accuracy tradeoffs and suggested canary config for a Dedicated pool.

Next steps: Can we book a 30-min sync Mon morning (CEST) to review the results and map to a canary plan? I'll bring Neha for pricing and Vivek for deployment options.
\Best,
Marissa

Attachments: benchmark-results-eu-apac-20260812.pdf (interim), multilingual_prompt_set_v1.csv
